test_abs_series: test the abs() method on a polars Series for integer and float values

test_builtin_abs: test the Python builtin abs() function on a polars Series with None values
test_abs_numpy: test NumPy abs() interop with a polars Series for integer and float types
test_abs_decimal: test the abs() method on a polars LazyFrame with Decimal dtype
test_abs_duration: test the abs() method on a polars LazyFrame with timedelta duration values
test_abs_overflow: test abs() overflow wrapping behavior for Int8 dtype
test_abs_unsigned: test abs() on an unsigned integer polars DataFrame column
test_abs_non_numeric: test that abs() raises InvalidOperationError for string dtype
test_abs_date: test that abs() raises InvalidOperationError for date dtype
